checks.name: primary_native_catalog_is_exact_and_bounded
checks.detail: The default workbench exposes exactly the ten accepted model-bound and model-free native workflows, including bounded MICOM/MGA v2 and NCA v2.

checks.name: native_second_batch_recipes_are_bounded
checks.detail: Native recipe descriptors promote only documented PLSc, WPLS, prediction, IPMA, and NCA scopes, with explicit method-specific guards.

checks.name: native_results_cover_second_batch_and_effect_workflows
checks.detail: Capability-derived native Results expose PLSc, WPLS, bounded prediction, predecessor-only 0-100 IPMA, mediation, and moderation tables only when genuine payload rows exist.

checks.name: cca_and_micom_mga_are_current_native_workflows
checks.detail: CCA is a packaged-accepted descriptive residual workflow and MICOM/MGA v2 is the bounded explicit-A/B measurement-invariance and permutation workflow.

checks.name: engine_messages_retain_bounded_claims
checks.detail: Estimator messages describe the exact validated numerical slices and preserve exclusions instead of labeling every later family experimental or implying full-method parity.

checks.name: plspredict_v2_is_packaged_indicator_first_native
checks.detail: PLSpredict/CVPAT v2 is accepted only after independent indicator/CVPAT reference evidence and a genuine packaged run/XLSX/save/reopen pass; saved-model comparison remains separate.

checks.name: nca_v2_is_packaged_model_free_native
checks.detail: NCA v2 is a packaged-accepted model-free native workflow while broader NCA variants remain excluded.

checks.name: micom_v2_is_owned_by_the_joint_third_batch_workflow
checks.detail: MICOM v2 is exposed only through the bounded joint group workflow; micom_v1 remains legacy-only.

checks.name: fimix_and_regression_stay_bounded_engine_only
checks.detail: FIMIX is an explicit bounded Predict-recipe metadata path and Regression has bounded recipe guards, but compact Prediction clears hidden segmentation and neither workflow is claimed in the primary catalog or native Results.

checks.name: bounded_engine_backlog_is_not_overclaimed_as_native
checks.detail: Later bounded engines remain documented with explicit exclusions and stay outside the primary native catalog until their desktop workflows are accepted.

checks.name: current_docs_and_evidence_accept_bounded_ipma
checks.detail: IPMA promotion is accepted only because the strict promotion artifact proves the genuine packaged run/export/save/reopen workflow; bounded-scope and cIPMA exclusions remain mandatory.

checks.name: native_workbench_docs_name_ten_accepted_workflows
checks.detail: The native workbench documentation records IPMA and model-free NCA alongside the ten accepted workflows while preserving bounded scopes.

note: Validated numerical or recipe support is not treated as packaged native acceptance. CCA, IPMA, MICOM/MGA v2, NCA v2, and indicator-level PLSpredict/CVPAT v2 require current packaged evidence; historical construct-score prediction v1, micom_v1, and nca_v1 remain legacy-only.
